description: Curated license conclusions for JVM build-graph components whose Maven metadata cannot supply an unambiguous SPDX identifier. scripts/build_jvm_inventory.py requires an entry here for every component with no POM, no <licenses> anywhere in its parent chain, an unrecognised license name, or more than one declared license, and fails if an entry no longer matches a resolved component. Conclusions recorded here are marked acknowledgement="concluded" in artifacts/sbom/jvm.cdx.json; POM-derived identifiers are marked "declared".

ca.weblite:java-objc-bridge:1.1.reason: OS-conditional macOS-only native (dependencyLocking ignoredDependencies); normalized platform-independently from verification-metadata and this override so macOS and Linux builds emit identical inventories. Upstream LICENSE is the Apache-2.0 text; its POM declares the same on platforms where it resolves.

com.google.guava:guava:33.7.2-jre.reason: The shared patched build-plugin and game-runtime version resolves using Gradle module metadata without a verification-pinned POM. Its exact verified JAR embeds META-INF/LICENSE containing Apache License Version 2.0; the owning version-tagged source LICENSE agrees.
